Looking at the CA coordinates around residue 47, the region seems to be part of a helical segment, so I'm checking backbone spacing between residues 43-49 to confirm helical geometry.

Computing i to i+4 distances (43-47, 44-48, 45-49, 47-51), all fall around 6.2-6.3 Å, which matches the expected alpha-helix spacing. This confirms residue 47 sits within a helical segment.
